reader_summary.headline: Frank Danieli is Head of Global Credit Solutions at MA Financial Group.
reader_summary.overview: Frank Danieli is Head of Global Credit Solutions at MA Financial Group. Frank began his career in restructurings, the self-described 'dark side of credit'. Our conversation discusses what global investors can learn from the model of private credit in Australia.

key_points.text: Frank Danieli is Head of Global Credit Solutions at MA Financial Group.
Frank began his career in restructurings, the self-described 'dark side of credit'.
We explore the evolution of private credit in Australia and why it developed differently from the sponsor-backed lending market in the U.S..
